rca of the issue: approval_decisions.decision_authority is declared `String(50)` in app/models.py (line ~730). The workflow.decide path writes `f'{role} via decision_rule {request_type} v{version}'`. For request_type='control_implementation_review' + role='issm' + version=1 this expands to 55 chars, which overflows the Postgres VARCHAR(50) column and raises psycopg StringDataRightTruncation inside db.flush/commit, which FastAPI returns as HTTP 500. Reproduction: as ISSO save a new implementation draft on LTP CM-6 → POST /systems/{sid}/workbench/implementations/{impl_id}/request-review → as ISSM POST /reviews/{req_id}/decisions {action:approve} → 500. Mitigation: widen the column to String(120) via `ALTER TABLE approval_decisions ALTER COLUMN decision_authority TYPE VARCHAR(120);` + model change + Alembic migration, OR shorten the authority writer. No data corruption on existing rows (the oversize insert is rolled back).
